description.zh:
网站业务的域名列表。

> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain names of the website services.

> The domain names must have website service forwarding rules configured. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

title.zh: 查询网站业务关联的DDoS高防实例信息
title.en: Query Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance information associated with website services

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-web-instance-relations --resource-group-id default --domains www.aliyun00.com --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
